title: GHSL AI agent and CodeQL find privileged workflow injection in PX4-Autopilot
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent and CodeQL
summary: A privileged workflow evaluates pull-request-controlled markdown-link checker output in a shell command; a crafted filename can inject shell commands when the workflow runs.
ai_role: The primary GHSL advisory explicitly credits both CodeQL and a GHSL-developed AI agent with discovery; the source does not apportion their contributions.
classification_note: The sources document the vulnerability and remediation, and make no claim of exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL reports the issue fixed 2025-08-15; the linked upstream advisory is GHSA-mq93-4g5w-w34h.

impacts.conditions: A pull request controls file paths in markdown-checker output that a privileged GitHub Actions workflow interpolates into a shell command. A crafted file name may cause command execution in that CI workflow context; compromise of a published artifact is not established here.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not state whether this issue was exploited in the wild.
